generate_circleci_config: run the script to regenerate config.yml from the config.in.yml Jinja2 template
generate_workflows: generate CircleCI workflow YAML entries for all conda build combinations of Python, PyTorch, and CUDA versions
generate_base_workflow: generate a base workflow dictionary for a specific Python, PyTorch, and CUDA version combination
generate_upload_workflow: generate an upload workflow dictionary that depends on a completed base workflow
get_pytorch_versions_for_python: get the list of PyTorch versions available for a given Python version
